lines: If Asagi-sensei got near us, and if the three of us were in a tight group, she'd just round us up in one fell swoop.
So I had developed a "three-dimensional" battle strategy. Basically a staggered battle line.
Maika! Defend the line you're on with your life!
Got it!! I won't let her get any closer!!!
One after another, explosive spheres flew out from Maika's Death Bazooka and engulfed the area in flames.
In this way, Maika controlled the intermediate distance with her fire and prevented Asagi-sensei's approach.
You don't have to tell me!
And from a safe distance further back, Hayate was attacking Asagi-sensei with her arrows.
Several arrows had hit Asagi-sensei and she had suffered quite a few wounds. Only scratches, though.
Yeah, but our opponent is Headmistress Asagi. Don't let your guard down.
I was giving orders and was ready to intercept with a melee weapon.
Fuma, I misjudged ya! Asagi-sensei's on the defensive! If we keep goin' like this...
All right, keep your distance. We'll retreat to the woods behind the school building.
What!? The woods!? But Asagi-sensei will have the advantage in a place with lots of cover!!
Yeah! She'll easily overpower us if we can't keep our distance!! We'll be at a disadvantage in the middle of all those trees!!
You're right, but we can't defeat Headmistress Asagi on this field. And aren't you two getting close to your limit?
I was right. We were fighting hard but had not been able deal decisive damage to Asagi-sensei.

On the other hand, Asagi-sensei was focusing on evading our attacks. Which meantー
she must have been waiting for Maika and Hayate to become fatigued.
Got it! I'll trust your commands!! Ya cool with that, Hayate?
Of course. Now, give us your order!
As we entered the forest behind the school building, Asagi-sensei used the trees as a shield and closed the distance between us right away.
Here she comes!!! Just like we thought!!!!
I will not let this tarnish my grades!!!
The two tried to block her approach, but Asagi-sensei made clever use of the trees and finally got close to them.
...Ugh!! She's fast! She's here already...!? Is she a monster!?
Asagi-sensei gave a flick of her long leg and Maika, followed by Hayate, fell to the ground unconscious.

We seemed to have lostー
but at that moment.
While concealing myself, I channeled all of my strength into my ninjato, and then leapt out from the shadow of a tree to attack Asagi-sensei.
And the next moment, everything went pitch dark.
The landscape of the forest behind the school had changed into a large, empty dome.
This facility was a virtual training complex.
Not only did it capture the scenery in 3D, but it could also recreate any kind of situation, down to the weather, gravity, smell, and even tactile sensations.
All the landscapes we had seen to this point had been virtual.
I grabbed the hand that Maika had held out to me and got up from the artificial floor.
Our opponent was the headmistress. Of course we were going to lose.
If you're going to feel down, you should come to class more often. Then I wouldn't have underestimated your skills.
Hayate patted me on the shoulder while looking away.
Oh? Hayate is tryin' to comfort Fuma!
Wha-!? No!! That is absolutely not true!!!
Hehe, don't be embarrassed. I'm startin' to think more of him too!
I'm telling you, it's not what it looks like! Anyway, what I'm trying to say is that all three of us are responsible!
Of course! We lost, but I'm glad that I teamed up with ya, Fuma!
(They are being surprisingly kind... even though we have to take the additional exam.)
(Actually, those two were strong enough. It's my lack of strength that made us lose...)
Alright! You did a good job. All three of you passed.
We couldn't believe our ears upon hearing those surprising words.
Did you really think you could win against Asagi-sama? You have done well in demonstrating your skills.
And you showed proper teamwork. As long as 1+1+1 is not less than 3 you pass. That's what this test was about.
W-We did it!! It didn't even hurt my grades...!
Quite out of character for the three of us, we clasped hands together and rejoiced.
Alright, Fuma! Party time! Let's have ice cream at Inageya! I'll buy ya one!
Now, don't go buying treats! Fuma, come to my house. I have some delicious tea sweets.
The ffff...? Is it possible to relax after such a grueling exam with something so prissy!? Ya damn princess!!!
D-... damn princess!? Don't speak to me in such vulgar manner! You damn delinquent!!!
Hey, Fuma! Ya hafta decide!! Of course it's me and Inageya, right!?
Alright, Fuma, tell her directly!! Tell her that you choose to come to my house!!!
Did this mean that I had grown on them?
Tell her that you are coming to my house!!!!
W-Wait! Don't pull my clothes!! They're gonna rip... aaahh...!!

And with that, we had passed the exam successfully. For the first time, I had made it through without an additional examー
But...
Instead of my allowance increasing, it was reduced to pay for my torn clothes. And for the time being, it seemed my life in poverty would continue...
